claims.quote: Schistura kodaguensis is a small nemacheilid loach from the Western Ghats of Karnataka, India, confirmed only from a tributary of the Cauvery.
Type locality is 'Kotu Hola, near Merkara, Karnataka, India' which corresponds to Kootu Hole near Madikeri in Coorg District within the Western Ghats mountains of southwestern Karnataka.

regions.name: Western Ghats

regions.name: Cauvery
regions.quote: Its wider distribution is unclear, with the single confirmed locality a tributary stream in the Cauvery (Kaveri) River system.
